invariants.rationale: The instantTime parameter is essential for insert operations, and it is expected to be non-null.
A list of records to be inserted must be provided, so hoodieRecords should be non-null.
A HoodieEngineContext is required to drive the engine operations, so context should be non-null.
List.size() is always non-negative; this expresses a property of the records list.
If instantTime is non-null, often it is expected to be a non-empty string representing a commit instant.
